name: Fuuun Aiuchi Gakuen Flat
original_name: 風雲相討学園フラット
source:
Step into the shoes of "Sakai Fukashi," the transfer student.  
Dive into a school filled with beautiful girls, each with their own quirks and flaws.  
Enjoy every wild moment of school life!  

[Translated from [url=https://negativegang.uijin.com/flat.html]the official website[/url]]
